result.summary: Identified 2 visual issues, including a missing navigational icon and a text truncation flaw.

issues.description: The 'Orders' tab in the bottom navigation bar is missing its icon.
issues.suggestion: Add the corresponding icon above the 'Orders' label.

issues.description: The third restaurant title 'Trattoria Piccol' cuts off abruptly without an ellipsis.
issues.suggestion: Apply a text-overflow ellipsis to truncated titles.
